answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, with transition mass attenuated whenever it crosses weakly connected regions. A sybil cluster therefore behaves like a karst pocket behind a sparse external cut: its low conductance limits escape probability and, by min-cut transitivity bounds, caps aggregate voting weight. Honest mixing acts as a lantern, keeping the global trust horizon beyond adversarial self-attestations.
